body: Pankaj Goyal (CFO) on 2026-02-10 (Q3FY26 concall transcript): "we expected our total capex for FY '26 to be in the range of INR400 crores to INR500 crores" Metric: Capex FY26. Target: INR 400-500 cr. Deadline: 2026-03-31. Specificity: range; volunteered. Status as of 2026-11-22: delivered. Evidence: 'capex of around Rs.460 crores deployed during FY 26' (Q4FY26 call). (In Aug-2025 the FY26 plan was ~INR 300 cr ex-solar; raised openly.)
